evidence.label: NHTSA Recall 14V047 - Ignition Switch Can Move Out of Run and Disable Air Bags

after.title: Ignition Switch Can Move Out of Run and Disable Air Bags (Recall 14V047)
after.description: Certain 2006-2011 Chevrolet HHR ignition switches can move out of Run because of key-ring weight or a jarring event, shutting off the engine and preventing air-bag deployment in a crash.
after.solution: Until repaired, remove other items and the fob from the key ring. Check the VIN for campaign 14V047; a Chevrolet dealer replaces the ignition switch, free of charge.
symptoms: Air bags may not deploy after the switch leaves Run
affectedSystems: ignition switch, engine electrical power and air-bag system
